download_cc3m_images: run the script to download CC3M training images from a TSV annotation file and save as JPEGs
generate_coco_image_info_json: run the script to generate a COCO-style JSON with image dimensions, captions, and category metadata
skip_image_download_mode: run the script with --not_download_image to skip wget and only process already-downloaded images into JSON
extract_image_dimensions_from_cc3m: run the script to open each CC3M image, convert to RGB, and extract height and width metadata
customize_cc3m_download_paths: run the script with custom --ann, --save_image_path, --cat_info, and --out_path arguments to control input and output locations
